messages:
anya: heads up - saw a customer hit a weird quota billing mismatch. SA token requests routed to project fallback path and the quota attribution ended up on the org project instead of the service account :grimace:
devon: ugh. which route specifically?
anya: looks like when auth proxy falls back to `project-key` we don't attach origin metadata. so the metering pipeline attributes to the project that owns the key, not the originating sa. only happens when token exchange fails (rare)
sam: can you paste the proxy log for one example?
anya: snippet: ```WARN proxy: token-exchange failed: 403
falling back to project-key route, origin_meta=null, request_id=cli-7684```
lee: wow null origin_meta is the root cause. our current telemetry relies on `x-origin-id` header populated by the auth service, but fallback path uses older proxy code that strips headers
ops-bot: deploy 7f3d applied to proxy-legacy yesterday 09:12 UTC :information_source:
product-qa: impact? is this just billing noise or quota enforcement gone wrong?
anya: both. billing attribution is wrong, and in some cases the project quota blocked requests that should have been charged to a different quota pool
devon: two fixes: (1) ensure fallback path preserves origin header; (2) add a deduped attribute in metering that prefers `x-origin-id` when present. also backfill a sampling pipeline to reassign recent events
sam: preserving header seems straightforward. here's a tiny change for legacy proxy config: ```preserve_headers: ["x-origin-id","x-tenant","x-org-id"]``` we can ship as a patch and canary to 5% traffic
lee: Agree. For the metering side we need a migration job to re-tag events where `origin_meta=null` but other signals indicate SA origin (key name patterns, request path). Might not be perfect but helps customers
product-qa: UX ask: Console needs a clear indicator when attribution was inferred vs explicit. Can we show a little badge on the Request Attribution panel: "inferred" with hover text?
anya: yes. Propose adding a telemetry flag `origin_inferred:true/false` into the metering event. Console can toggle color based on that.
devon: rollout plan: patch proxy -> canary 5% -> monitor error rate and attribution ratio -> patch metering -> backfill sampler -> console badge release. total ETA ~1 week if no surprises
sam: metrics to watch: ratio(origin_meta==null), rate of 403 token-exchange, percent of requests with inferred attribution, billing delta by customer. I'll add dashboards
ops-bot: canary promoted to 5% at 2026-03-20T15:04:23Z
lee: owners: devon (proxy patch), sam (metering/dashboards), anya (console badge + customer comms). I'll file the follow-up ticket and link PRs
product-qa: thanks. can we notify CS for any tenants with large billing deltas?
anya: yes, I'll run a quick query to surface tenants with >5% delta and ping cs-channel
devon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/proxy/pull/482 - small header-preserve change. PTAL :eyes:
sam: created dashboard: "authz-attribution-health" - temporary until we wire into the main console. Sharing panel links in the ticket
anya: ok moving to action. will update thread with CS list and reassign once backfill runs.
